body.x: UAG (www.urbanarmorgear.com), a leading designer of smartphone cases with engineered drop protection, unveiled "Urban Armor Gear Cases" at CES 2015, which runs Jan. 6-9 in Las Vegas.Urban Armor Gear Cases are approved by Met Laboratories, a NEBS Certified testing laboratory. The test is compliant with MIL-STD-810G 516.6, passing rigorous test of dropping from a height of 48 inches 26 times and must function properly after the test, while not sustaining any damage to the touch screen. This featherweight cases offer military-grade shock protection for smartphones and smart tablets, without adding extra bulk.
